title: Complete First-Party Campaign
objective: Produce one polished first-party campaign designed to exercise Multiversal end to end as an actual game experience rather than a QA corpus.

scope.purpose: Create and package one coherent first-party campaign over the completed content, creator-studio and runtime systems.
included: a polished first-party Campaign with documented Player and GM paths
coherent use of the major applicable Multiversal systems
replayable Adventure/Campaign progression without developer intervention
SMB-08 first-party governed content packs as reusable content input
governed World, Adventure, Character/NPC/Creature, organization, travel, encounter, investigation, economy/crafting, vehicle/base and systemic consequence owner integrations where applicable
ARI-governed first-party presentation resources and existing studio outputs
scope.completion_gate: The campaign uses the major applicable systems coherently and can be completed/replayed through documented Player/GM paths with no developer intervention.

boundaries: SMB-08 is sealed completed_verified and remains the first-party core-content-library source; SMB-09 consumes it rather than replacing or rewriting its pack authority.
The Campaign is a real first-party game experience, not a synthetic QA corpus or fixture-only proof.
Campaign/World/Adventure/owner domains retain canonical state and mutation authority; SMB-09 creates no replacement gameplay or state ledger.
Existing MCS/MCCS/MNCS/MAS/MSAS/MRCS/GPR/MERA/MBES/MSLR/MSWI capabilities are consumed through their sealed contracts rather than reimplemented.
First-party media remains ARI-governed; no SMB-only asset library or rights ledger is created.
External tester distribution, public release, paid providers, commerce and public community activation remain outside SMB-09 unless separately governed.
Normal successor is SAA-01. SAA and SMB-10 remain unauthorized until verified SMB-09 closeout and fresh roadmap reconciliation.
next_action: Establish causal RED for the bounded SMB-09 first-party Campaign package/player-path/GM-path/replay seam, then implement only governed Campaign composition over sealed owner-domain, studio/runtime and SMB-08 content authorities.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started SMB-09 from completed_verified SMB-08.
